Ideal candidate

We are looking for a passionate and motivated developer who is eager to learn new technologies and grow in an ambitious, fast-evolving environment. You will work on modern web and mobile applications that are actively used at scale, contributing to both new features and continuous improvements.︎︈︌︄︃️︆︆︌︋︆︍︁︁︎︌︋︌︆︋️︎︆︇︍︊︎︋︈︈︈︈

What we expect from you

  • Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (Angular, React, or Vue)
  • Experience working with relational databases (MySQL is a plus)


Nice to have

  • Experience with the Ionic platform or native Android / iOS development
  • Experience with Node.js and Express.js
  • Working with REST APIs


Good understanding of Git and collaborative development workflows

If you are passionate about programming but don’t yet meet all the listed requirements—or if you’re motivated to learn modern web and mobile development technologies—we still encourage you to apply.

Job description


What you will do

  • Develop new features and enhance existing ones on our cloud platform and mobile applications
  • Collaborate closely with other developers, product owners, and stakeholders
  • Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code


Tools & Technologies

  • DevOps tools for planning and task management
  • Microsoft Teams & Office for collaboration
  • Bitbucket for version control
  • WebStorm as the primary IDE


What we offer

  • A supportive team of skilled colleagues to learn from and share knowledge with
  • Work on interesting, long-term projects with real impact
  • Flexible working hours and home office options
  • A fair and competitive salary based on skills and performance


Company desciption

Homefile is an innovative Romanian company with over 10 years of experience, dedicated to making facility management transparent and efficient through a modern cloud platform. Today, our solution is used to manage more than 300,000 apartments across 40+ cities, and we are continuously growing.
